title: Divide Array in Sets of K Consecutive Numbers
summary: Given an array of integers and a positive integer k, determine if the array can be divided into sets of k consecutive numbers.
statement: Given an array of integers and a positive integer k, determine if the array can be divided into sets of k consecutive numbers. Return true if possible, otherwise return false.
constraints: Every group must contain k consecutive distinct values.
Every input occurrence must belong to exactly one group.
hints: The smallest remaining value must start a group.
Count values, then consume its multiplicity from every value in the next k positions.
Reject a shortage; continue through keys in sorted order.
No earlier value can precede the smallest remaining one, so the greedy start is forced.
editorial: No earlier value can precede the smallest remaining one, so the greedy start is forced.

tests.explanation: The groups 1,2,3,4 and 3,4,5,6 use every value.
Two copies of 1,2,3 form two valid groups.
